title: Object category decoding from MEG
scientific_question: Can MEG distinguish object categories on unseen exemplars while controlling shared image identity?
primary_outputs: Category scores in a fixed prespecified temporal summary.

data_manifest.version: OpenNeuro2.0.1 (dataset DOI in current BIDS metadata)

example_asset.scope: Main run data only; CTF sidecars add space

recording_contract.neural: CTF MEG sensor recordings (.ds/.meg4) plus channel,head position and trigger metadata
recording_contract.labels: Actual events.tsv: onset,duration,trial_type,things_category_nr,value,sample; sample_attributes_P*.csv provides epoch metadata
recording_contract.time_alignment: Pinned loader replaces trigger sample positions with optical-sensor-corrected event sample column; filters0.1–40Hz,epochs−0.1to1.3s,downsamples200Hz.
recording_contract.biological_ids: participants.tsv explicitly lists BIGMEG1–4;12sessions per participant
recording_contract.evidence: BIDS dataset_description/participants/events and S3 recording manifest inspected; pinned preprocessing source accesses those fields

case_definition: One isolated biological-unit/session packet under the split policy; multiple scored observations are nested items, not independent biological cases.

split.policy: Group repeated image identities/concepts; whole sessions and participant holdouts; preserve source-corrected trigger timing.
split.uncertainty: Biological-unit paired uncertainty where multiple units exist; single-animal/person tasks use descriptive session/trial blocks and do not imply population replication.

reference.role: Official preprocessing and time-resolved decoding analyses; dependencies, payload QC and numerical results remain untested.

common_policy.fixed_program: Freeze program and fitting/adaptation recipe before query access; any target-batch adaptation must be explicitly permitted.
common_policy.case_adaptive: Same allowed data, checkpoint tools, context batch and accounted compute; no evaluator labels/feedback; reset case state as specified.
common_policy.model_tools: Compare generic numerical tools, supplied decoder alone, and matched agent-plus-decoder arms. Record checkpoint training exposure and preparation cost.
common_policy.investigation: Require estimand, numeric artifacts, uncertainty, alternative explanations and executable evidence; independent scorer verifies them.

observable_endpoints.definition: Participant-macro balanced accuracy; temporal curves remain secondary.

evaluation.comparability: Task variants and related outcomes share source/family evidence. Never sum task counts as independent cohorts or average unlike native metrics.
